title: QueryObject for Mailbox uses MailboxFilterCondition but handler never calls query_objects::<Mailbox>
description: handle_mailbox_query calls get_objects::<Mailbox> (fetch all) and filters in-process. It never calls backend.query_objects::<Mailbox>. The QueryObject impl for Mailbox now specifies MailboxFilterCondition as Filter type, but no handler passes it to the backend. Backend implementors who implement query_objects::<Mailbox> with proper MailboxFilterCondition filtering will find their implementation dead code — the handler bypasses it entirely. This is a public trait method that leads implementors to invest in work that is never exercised.
